people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
translations.bsb: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
translations.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
translations.asv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold unto David.
